title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Advantages of Discussing Ideas in Groups
prompt: In many workplaces and educational settings, people discuss ideas in groups rather than working alone. Some people believe that group discussion leads to better decisions and more creative outcomes, while others think it can slow down progress and dilute individual responsibility. What are the advantages of discussing ideas in a group compared with working individually? To what extent do you agree that these advantages outweigh the disadvantages? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类写作Task 2练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，非官方雅思试卷。请先仔细阅读题目，明确要求讨论小组讨论相较于个人工作的优势，并表明你在多大程度上同意这些优势大于劣势。建议用5分钟规划，40分钟写作，写至少250词。注意：不要只描述数据或图表；要提出明确立场并用理由和例子支持。写完后检查任务回应、连贯与衔接、词汇资源、语法多样性与准确性。
